description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Appointed Mr. Dayantha Laksiri Mendis as Hon. Consul of Republic of Guyana at Colombo w.e.f. 28.11.2014
categorisation: This gazette notification names a specific individual (Mr. Dayantha Laksiri Mendis) and announces his appointment to a government position (Honorary Consul of the Republic of Guyana at Colombo). It does not include any detailed descriptions of his portfolio responsibilities, duties, or subject areas he will oversee, which makes it a pure personnel announcement fitting Type 2 (People Gazette).
